```{r load data C vs NC}
gsea_files = c(

list.files("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/dge_analysis/CvsNC_preR/", pattern="v3_DESeq2woBatch_", full.name=T) %>% grep("gsea.csv", ., value=T),
list.files("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/dge_analysis/CvsNC_postR1/", pattern="v3_DESeq2woBatch_", full.name=T) %>% grep("gsea.csv", ., value=T),
```

```{r generate heatmaps - C vs NC}

# Can include only one pathway at a time
paths = c("HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB")
paths_short = c("TNF-a signaling NFKB") %>%
    setNames(paths)

my_gsea_res = all_gsea_res_CvsNA[ all_gsea_res_CvsNA$pathway %in% paths & !is.na(all_gsea_res_CvsNA$padj) & all_gsea_res_CvsNA$padj < 0.1, ]

#final_ct_list = grep("Mo|DC|NK_|CD4_|CD8_|B_|Plasmablasts",all_ct, value=T) 
tnf_ctypes = c("cMo","cDC2","pDC","B_IgM+IgD+","B_mem_not_switched","CD4_naive","CD4_memory_NOS","CD8_naive","NK_adaptive_1","NK_adaptive_2")
final_ct_list = tnf_ctypes
comps = c("preATI","preR")

plotlist = list()
for(ct in unique(my_gsea_res$ctype)) {
  ct = gsub("_deseq","",ct)
  if(! modify_annot(ct) %in% final_ct_list)
    next
  print(ct)
  plotlist[[modify_annot(ct)]] = list()
  cd = pb_list[[ct]]
  for(cm in comps) {
    if(cm == "postR2")
      next
    # Subset to samples of interest
    cd_tmp = cd %>% select(contains(cm)) %>% select(contains( as.character(p_meta$pid[ p_meta$outcome %in% c("C","NC")]) ))    # Keep features that are expressed with CPM > 1 in more than 50% of samples in one or both outcome groups.
    meta_tmp = meta[ match(colnames(cd_tmp), meta$pid_tp), ]
    feats = names(which(apply(cpm(cd_tmp) > 1, 1, function(x) { any(tapply(x, meta_tmp$outcome, mean) > 0.5) } )))
    print(length(feats))
    cd_tmp = cd_tmp[feats,]
    cd_tmp = as.data.frame(cpm(cd_tmp))
    # Scale the data
    cd_tmp = apply(cd_tmp, 1, scale) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% setNames(colnames(cd_tmp))
    gsea_tmp = my_gsea_res[ my_gsea_res$ctype == ct & my_gsea_res$comp == cm, ]
    if(nrow(gsea_tmp) == 0)
      next
    res = data.frame()
    for(p in gsea_tmp$pathway) {
      lgenes = unlist(str_split(gsea_tmp$leadingEdge[gsea_tmp$pathway == p], ", "))
      if(sum(! lgenes %in% rownames(cd_tmp)) > 0) {
        warning(paste0(ct, "_", cm, ":", p, ":missing genes ", sum(! lgenes %in% rownames(cd_tmp))))
        warning( paste0( setdiff(lgenes, rownames(cd_tmp)), collapse=", "))
      }
      lgenes = lgenes[ lgenes %in% rownames(cd_tmp) ]
      score = colMeans(cd_tmp[lgenes,])
      res = rbind(res, data.frame(
        pid=str_extract(names(score), "^\\d+"), 
        tp=str_extract(names(score), "[^_]+$"),
        score = score,
        p = p
      ) %>% mutate(outcome = p_meta$outcome[ match(pid, p_meta$pid) ]) )
    }
    res = pivot_wider(res, names_from=p, values_from=score)
    res = as.data.frame(res)
    res$tp = rename_tp(res$tp)
    cm2 = rename_tp(cm)
    rownames(res) = paste0(res$pid, "_", res$tp)
    res$tp = NULL

    colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)] = paths_short[colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)]]

    stars = c()
    for(i in 3:ncol(res)){ 
        p=wilcox.test( res[res$outcome == "C",i], res[res$outcome == "NC",i])$p.value
        s = ""
        if(p < 0.05)
          s = "*"
        stars = c(stars, s)
    }
    colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)] = paste0(colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)], stars)

    cluster_cols = ncol(res) > 3
    
    #ha = ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
    #  vl = vl$VL[ match( rownames(res), rename_tp(vl$pid_tp) )],
    #  col = list(
    #    vl = circlize::colorRamp2(range(vl$VL), c("white","orange"))
    #  )
    #)
    
    #plotlist[[paste0(ct, "#", cm)]] = 
    plotlist[[modify_annot(ct)]][[cm]] = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
      res[,3:ncol(res), drop=F], 
      cluster_columns = cluster_cols, 
      row_split = factor(res$outcome, levels=c("C","NC")), 
      cluster_row_slices = FALSE, 
      #left_annotation = ha, 
      width = unit(0.4*(ncol(res)-2), "in" ), 
      height = unit(0.4*(nrow(res)-2), "in" ) )
  }
}

plotlist_CvsNC = plotlist

```

```{r leading-edge log2 diff heatmap - C vs NC }

#### Fig 7B

# Selected leading-edge genes to plot
tnf_CvsNC_preATI = c("TRAF1","TNFAIP3","NFKBIA","NFKB1","IL23A","IL1B","ICOSLG","CCL4","CCL20","RIPK2","IL1A","IFNGR2","CXCL2","CD83","CD80","CCL2","IL15RA","TLR2","REL","TNF","RIGI","RELB","NFKB2","IFIT2","IRF1","IL6ST","CD69","IL6","CXCL3","CXCL10","CXCL1","CSF1","CEBPB","CCL5")

tnf_CvsNC_preR = c("JUN","FOSB","FOS","CD69","IL1B","BCL2A1","FOSL1","CCL4","TNF","IL23A","NFKB1","KDM6B","NFAT5","ICAM1","RELB","CCL5","IL6")


tp = 'preATI'
path = "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"
path_short = "TNF-a signaling NFKB"
if(tp == 'preATI') {
  ctypes = preati_ctypes
  genes = tnf_CvsNC_preATI
  out_file = paste0("../../../../10x/dge_analysis/leading_edge_log2fc_heatmap_CvsNC_tnfa_",tp,".pdf")
} else if(tp == 'preR') {
  ctypes = c("B_mem_not_switched","CD4_naive","CD8_naive")
  genes = tnf_CvsNC_preR
  out_file = paste0("../../../../10x/dge_analysis/leading_edge_log2fc_heatmap_CvsNC_tnfa_",tp,".pdf")
}

my_gsea_res = all_gsea_res_CvsNA[ all_gsea_res_CvsNA$pathway %in% path & !is.na(all_gsea_res_CvsNA$padj) & all_gsea_res_CvsNA$padj < 0.1, ]



df = data.frame()
for(ctype in ctypes) {
  gsea_idx = my_gsea_res$ctype == ctype & my_gsea_res$comp == tp
  if(sum(gsea_idx) != 1) {
    stop("Found more than 1 matching gsea results for ", tp, ":", ctype)
  } 
  le_genes = intersect(genes, unlist(str_split(my_gsea_res$leadingEdge[gsea_idx], ", ")))
  tmp_df = all_dge_logfc_CvsNA[[paste0(tp, "#", ctype)]][le_genes,,drop=F] %>% 
    na.omit() %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(ctype = ctype)
  df = rbind(df, tmp_df)
}

df = pivot_wider(df, names_from = gene, values_from = logFC) %>% column_to_rownames("ctype")
if(ncol(df) != length(genes)) {
  warning("Missing a few genes in ", tp, "\n", paste0(genes[! genes %in% colnames(df)], collapse = ","), "\n")
}

col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c( min(-1, min(df, na.rm = T)), 0, max( max(df, na.rm = T), 1) ), c("blue", "white", "red"))

p = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(df,
    width = unit(0.25*(ncol(df)-4), "in" ), 
    height = unit(0.2*(nrow(df)), "in" ),
    col = col_fun,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    column_title = paste0(tp, ":", path_short),
    cluster_columns = FALSE
    )

pdf(out_file, width=15, height=6)
print(p)
dev.off()


```

```{r generate heatmaps - between TPs}

# Can include only one pathway at a time
paths = c("HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB","HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE")
paths_short = c("TNF-a signaling NFKB","IFNa response") %>%
    setNames(paths)

my_gsea_res = all_gsea_res_bwTP[ all_gsea_res_bwTP$pathway %in% paths & !is.na(all_gsea_res_bwTP$padj) & all_gsea_res_bwTP$padj < 0.1, ]
my_gsea_res$comp = gsub("_vs_preATI","",my_gsea_res$comp)

ifn_bnab_ctypes = c("cDC2")
ifn_prer_ctypes = c("cMo","cDC2","pDC","ncMo_cd16mid", "ncMo_cd16high")
tnf_bnab_ctypes = c("cMo","ncMo_cd16mid","cDC2","pDC")
tnf_prer_ctypes = c("cMo","ncMo_cd16mid", "ncMo_cd16high","cDC2","pDC")

final_ct_list = unique(c(ifn_bnab_ctypes, ifn_prer_ctypes, tnf_bnab_ctypes, tnf_prer_ctypes))
comps = c("bNAb","preR")


plotlist = list()
for(ct in unique(my_gsea_res$ctype)) {
  ct = gsub("_deseq","",ct)
  if(! modify_annot(ct) %in% final_ct_list)
    next
  print(ct)
  plotlist[[modify_annot(ct)]] = list()
  cd = pb_list[[ct]]
  for(cm in unique(my_gsea_res$comp)[ rename_tp(unique(my_gsea_res$comp)) %in% comps] ) {
    if(cm == "postR2")
      next
    # Subset to tp of interest (pair)
    cd_tmp = cd %>% select(contains(c("preATI", cm))) %>% select(contains(meta$pid_tp))
    feats=names(which(rowMeans(cpm(cd_tmp) > 1) > 0.4))
    print(length(feats))
    cd_tmp = cd_tmp[feats,]
    cd_tmp = as.data.frame(cpm(cd_tmp))
    # Scale the data
    cd_tmp = apply(cd_tmp, 1, scale) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% setNames(colnames(cd_tmp))
    gsea_tmp = my_gsea_res[ my_gsea_res$ctype == ct & my_gsea_res$comp == cm, ]
    if(nrow(gsea_tmp) == 0)
      next
    res = data.frame()
    for(p in gsea_tmp$pathway) {
      lgenes = unlist(str_split(gsea_tmp$leadingEdge[gsea_tmp$pathway == p], ", "))
      if(sum(! lgenes %in% rownames(cd_tmp)) > 0) {
        warning(paste0(ct, "_", cm, ":", p, ":missing genes ", sum(! lgenes %in% rownames(cd_tmp))))
        warning( paste0( setdiff(lgenes, rownames(cd_tmp)), collapse=", "))
      }
      lgenes = lgenes[ lgenes %in% rownames(cd_tmp) ]
      score = colMeans(cd_tmp[lgenes,])
      res = rbind(res, data.frame(
        pid=str_extract(names(score), "^\\d+"), 
        tp=str_extract(names(score), "[^_]+$"),
        score = score,
        p = p
      ))
    }
    res = pivot_wider(res, names_from=p, values_from=score)
    res = as.data.frame(res)
    res$tp = rename_tp(res$tp)
    cm2 = rename_tp(cm)
    rownames(res) = paste0(res$pid, "_", res$tp)

    colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)] = paths_short[colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)]]

    stars = c()
    for(i in 3:ncol(res)){ 
        p=wilcox.test( res[res$tp == "preATI",i], res[res$tp == cm2,i])$p.value
        s = ""
        if(p < 0.05)
          s = "*"
        stars = c(stars, s)
    }
    colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)] = paste0(colnames(res)[3:ncol(res)], stars)

    cluster_cols = ncol(res) > 3
    
    #ha = ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
    #  vl = vl$VL[ match( rownames(res), rename_tp(vl$pid_tp) )],
    #  col = list(
    #    vl = circlize::colorRamp2(range(vl$VL), c("white","orange"))
    #  )
    #)
    
    #plotlist[[paste0(ct, "#", cm)]] = 
    plotlist[[modify_annot(ct)]][[cm2]] = 
      ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(res[,3:ncol(res), drop=F], 
                              cluster_columns = cluster_cols, 
                              row_split = factor(res$tp, levels=c("preATI",cm2)), 
                              cluster_row_slices = FALSE, 
                              #left_annotation = ha, 
                              width = unit(0.2*(ncol(res)-2), "in" ), 
                              height = unit(0.2*(nrow(res)-2), "in" ) )
  }
}

plotlist_bwTP = plotlist
```

```{r leading-edge log2 diff heatmap - bw TP }
tp = 'bNAb'
path = "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"
#path = "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE"

if(path == "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB") {
  path_short = "TNF-a signaling NFKB"
  if(tp == 'bNAb') {
    ctypes = tnf_bnab_ctypes
    genes = tnf_bwTP_bNAb
    out_file = paste0("../../../../10x/dge_analysis/leading_edge_log2fc_heatmap_bwTP_tnfa_",tp,".pdf")
  } else if(tp == 'preR') {
    ctypes = tnf_prer_ctypes
    genes = tnf_bwTP_preR
    out_file = paste0("../../../../10x/dge_analysis/leading_edge_log2fc_heatmap_bwTP_tnfa_",tp,".pdf")
  }
} else if(path == "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE") {
  path_short = "IFNa response"
  if(tp == 'bNAb') {
    ctypes = ifn_bnab_ctypes
    genes = ifn_bwTP_bNAb
    out_file = paste0("../../../../10x/dge_analysis/leading_edge_log2fc_heatmap_bwTP_ifna_",tp,".pdf")
  } else if(tp == 'preR') {
    ctypes = ifn_prer_ctypes
    genes = ifn_bwTP_preR
    out_file = paste0("../../../../10x/dge_analysis/leading_edge_log2fc_heatmap_bwTP_ifna_",tp,".pdf")
  }
}

my_gsea_res = all_gsea_res_bwTP[ all_gsea_res_bwTP$pathway %in% path & !is.na(all_gsea_res_bwTP$padj) & all_gsea_res_bwTP$padj < 0.1, ]

my_gsea_res$comp = rename_tp(gsub("_vs_preATI","",my_gsea_res$comp))



df = data.frame()
for(ctype in ctypes) {
  gsea_idx = my_gsea_res$ctype == ctype & my_gsea_res$comp == tp
  if(sum(gsea_idx) != 1) {
    stop("Found more than 1 matching gsea results for ", tp, ":", ctype)
  } 
  le_genes = intersect(genes, unlist(str_split(my_gsea_res$leadingEdge[gsea_idx], ", ")))
  tmp_df = all_dge_logfc_bwTP[[paste0(tp, "#", ctype)]][le_genes,,drop=F] %>% 
    na.omit() %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(ctype = ctype)
  df = rbind(df, tmp_df)
}

df = pivot_wider(df, names_from = gene, values_from = logFC) %>% column_to_rownames("ctype")
if(ncol(df) != length(genes)) {
  warning("Missing a few genes in ", tp, "\n", paste0(genes[! genes %in% colnames(df)], collapse = ","), "\n")
}

col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c( min(-1, min(df, na.rm = T)), 0, max( max(df, na.rm = T), 1) ), c("blue", "white", "red"))

p = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(df,
    width = unit(0.25*(ncol(df)-4), "in" ), 
    height = unit(0.2*(nrow(df)), "in" ),
    col = col_fun,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    column_title = paste0(tp, ":", path_short),
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title=paste0("log2(",tp,"/preATI)"))
    )

pdf(out_file, width=15, height=6)
print(p)
dev.off()
```
